notes.title: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul Demo Released!
notes.content:
👋  Exciting news everyone! 

We are really happy to announce the release of the demo of our latest adventure game "Alchemist: Journey of the Soul"! 

We have been working on it for quite some time now and we can finally share it with you, in order to get your precious feedback!

You can wishlist ❤️  the game and play the demo here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115240?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=DEMOannouncement

Thank you,
OnSkull Games

notes.title: Unsafe is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce our latest game "Unsafe", a horror coop game. We have been working on Unsafe for quite a few months now and we have finally decided to share it with you!

You can wishlist the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756160/Unsafe/]Unsame on Steam[/url]

As we get closer to our early access release date, we will be posting more information / media from the game and keep you up to date with our progress. In the mean time, you can ask any questions you have on the Discussions page, we will do our best to answer!

We can't wait to see where this game goes with your help and suggestions!

Thank you
OnSkull Games

notes.title: Escape First 2 is out!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094060/Escape_First_2]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35143621/761eb6e41141c7fd69753a36d46e9ef6d060fc8c.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Escape First 2 is the second entry in the series, bringing you more rooms and more refined interactions. Gather up to six people and work together to solve puzzles and escape before time is up!

(You can play the games in either order, they are largely independent)


You can find Escape First 2 here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094060/Escape_First_2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094060/Escape_First_2[/url]

Thank you and have a great time escaping!

notes.title: Curious Cases is out!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32627052/b7994f16869986a8f16532f53ee17bdf6e83a526.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce our latest game, [b]Curious Cases[/b]! 

[b]Curious Cases[/b] is a remaster of the [b]multiplayer escape-room[/b] formula, taking you on an adventure, playing as Detective Moore to solve the [b]Mystery[/b] of the missing scientist! Exciting new puzzles and interactions await!

If you have enjoyed Escape First and have wanted more, you should give this a look! You can get it now for 20% OFF here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045080/Curious_Cases/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045080/Curious_Cases/[/url]

Thank you,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: Escape First Update Patch
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We just released a new update for the game, addressing some of the issues you have brought to our attention in the last week.

Here is a brief list of some of our changes:
[list]
[*] Changed "Theory of Relativity" riddle and hint.
[*] Fixed colliders in Red Button's last room
[*] Improved the in-game hint for Red Button's drink riddle
[*] Fixed a bug with Versus mode and the "Give Hint" button.
[*] Fixed colliders in Lost In Time.
[/list]

Thank you for playing,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: Escape First is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32627052/5c11dac92ff87eaf7e60e2742b1237bcb0890502.png[/img]

[h1]Hello and welcome to Escape First![/h1]

[b][u]Escape First[/u][/b] is a multiplayer escape room adventure game that features three unique experiences to play through! Gather up to six people and work together to solve puzzles and escape before time is up!

[i]But wait, there is more[/i],  you can choose to play as a Team, using cooperation to win the game, or you can enable [b]Challenge Mode[/b] hand race your friends to the exit!

[i]Who will Escape First?[/i]

Thank you and have a great time escaping!
